Hadith.4863 - Ḥammad ibn ʿIsa narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
I asked him, "If a free woman is married to a slave, how many divorces can he pronounce against her?"
He (as) replied: "Ali (as) said: 'Divorce and the waiting period (ʿiddah) are determined according to the status of the women.'"
